# Ezzulddin Al-Sammarraie
> Telecommunications Engineer, Junior NOC, and DevOps / Systems Administrator based in Bucharest, Romania.

Digital portfolio and verified engineering proof-of-work for Ezzulddin. Specializes in Linux systems, Go, Bash scripting, containerized infrastructure (Docker), telemetry/monitoring (Prometheus/Grafana), and upstream open-source infrastructure development.

## Featured Open-Source Contributions
- Linux Foundation FabricOps (PR #35 - Merged): Added YAML serialization support for fabricopsctl status CLI in Go.
- Limusic Desktop (PR #58 - Merged): Implemented cross-platform webview zoom scaling controls in Tauri.
- Kubernetes kprompt (PR #113 - Merged): Implemented planner-level gatekeeper rejecting unsupported Kubernetes scale kinds in Go.
- Canvas API MCP (PR #25 - Merged): Hardened HTTP error handling and prevented credential token leakage in Python.
- LazyFTP (PR #57 - Merged): Fixed visible row boundary calculation in terminal UI processes panel in Go.
- Canonical LXD (PR #18852 - In Review): Resolved async API race condition in operation wait endpoint in Go.
- LibreDesk (PR #452 - Approved/Queued): Resolved inline CSS dark mode text invisibility issue in Vue/SCSS.
- Crunchyroll Downloader (PR #31 - In Review): Rewrote memory allocation in Go to stream 7GB+ payloads directly to disk without OOM.

## Pinned Projects
- IoT NOC Monitoring Lab (https://github.com/IzzaldinSamir/iot-noc-monitoring-lab): Multi-container Docker Compose observability stack featuring Mosquitto MQTT, Prometheus, Grafana, Go-based TCP/HTTP health checks, and ITIL L2 Wireshark triage runbooks.
- Minimalist Terminal Portfolio (https://github.com/IzzaldinSamir/portfolio-site): Zero-framework, 100/100 Lighthouse performance portfolio deployed via Cloudflare Pages CI/CD.
